keyEvents.text: Goal! Stoke City 1, Millwall 0. George Hirst (Stoke City) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jack McGlynn with a through ball.
Luke Graham (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jenson Metcalfe (Millwall).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Stoke City 2, Millwall 0. George Hirst (Stoke City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Million Manhoef.
Derek Mazou-Sacko (Millwall) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Stoke City 2, Millwall 0.
Substitution, Millwall. Kyrell Lisbie replaces Taïryk Arconte.
Substitution, Millwall. Lyndon Dykes replaces Mihailo Ivanovic.
Substitution, Millwall. Daniel Kelly replaces Jenson Metcalfe.
Second Half begins Stoke City 2, Millwall 0.
Substitution, Stoke City. Svante Ingelsson replaces Million Manhoef.
Substitution, Millwall. Luke Cundle replaces Derek Mazou-Sacko.
Daniel Kelly (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stoke City. Sam Gallagher replaces Ethan Galbraith.
Substitution, Stoke City. Róbert Bozeník replaces George Hirst.
Substitution, Millwall. Elkan Baggott replaces Alfie Doughty.
Goal! Stoke City 2, Millwall 1. Mark Sykes (Millwall) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Jake Cooper.
Substitution, Stoke City. Aaron Cresswell replaces Bae Jun-Ho.
Lyndon Dykes (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jordi Osei-Tutu (Millwall).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Kyrell Lisbie (Millwall) is shown the yellow card.
